metaDescription: Digital marketing for Iowa businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for agribusiness, manufacturers and local firms from Des Moines to Dubuque.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Iowa businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Iowa is a farm state with a strong insurance and manufacturing base, and its customers are spread across a handful of cities and a great many small towns. We help Iowa companies reach buyers across that distance without paying for attention they cannot use.

sections.heading: Where Iowa's customers are
paragraphs: Des Moines, in the centre, is the capital and the largest metro, known for insurance and financial services. Cedar Rapids is an industrial city built on grain processing and avionics, and Iowa City next door is home to the University of Iowa and its hospitals. Ames has Iowa State University and a strong agricultural research community. Waterloo and Cedar Falls are closely tied to tractor manufacturing.

The edges of the state face outward. Davenport and Bettendorf share the Quad Cities with Illinois across the Mississippi. Dubuque sits where Iowa meets Wisconsin and Illinois. Council Bluffs is part of the Omaha area, and Sioux City serves a corner where three states meet. Businesses there have customers and competitors on the other side of a river.
Everywhere else, Iowa is county seats and small towns surrounded by corn and soybean fields. People there are used to driving for what they need, and they research before they set off.

sections.heading: Agriculture shapes more than farms
paragraphs: Iowa is among the country's largest producers of corn, soybeans, pork and eggs, and a wide range of companies depend on that: equipment makers and dealers, seed and crop input suppliers, grain elevators, ethanol plants, livestock services, lenders and insurers. The state is also a major producer of wind energy, which has brought its own contractors and suppliers.

The farm year sets the timing. Decisions about seed and inputs are made over winter, planting takes over in spring, and nobody has time to talk during harvest in autumn. Marketing aimed at growers should arrive in the quieter months, load quickly on a phone with a weak signal and get to the point.
bullets: Content and campaigns scheduled around planting and harvest.
Product and dealer pages that are easy to use on a phone in the field.
Search visibility for specific equipment, parts and services.

sections.heading: Being found across a wide area
paragraphs: An Iowa business often serves several counties. A clinic in Mason City, an implement dealer in Carroll or a remodeller in Marshalltown needs to appear when someone thirty miles away searches. That takes a properly set service area in your business profile, pages that name the towns you cover and reviews from customers in those towns.

Local events move demand too. The Iowa State Fair fills Des Moines in August, RAGBRAI sends thousands of cyclists through a different chain of small towns each July, and home football Saturdays in Iowa City and Ames pack hotels and restaurants. Winters are cold and snowy, which shifts work toward heating, snow removal and indoor projects.

faqs.a: No. We work with Iowa businesses remotely, using video calls, shared documents and regular reporting.

faqs.q: Does online marketing work in small Iowa towns?
faqs.a: Yes. People in rural areas search on their phones before driving anywhere, and there is often little competition in the results. An accurate business profile, real reviews and a simple, fast website can put a small-town business ahead of larger rivals.

faqs.q: When is the right time to advertise to Iowa farmers?
faqs.a: Generally outside planting and harvest, when growers have time to compare options. Winter is when many purchasing decisions are made. We set the calendar with you based on what you sell.

faqs.q: What does a marketing agency cost for an Iowa business?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope of the work: the channels, the content and the area you want to cover. We give a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long before SEO brings in customers in Iowa?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements and brief, your current site and the competition for your terms. We agree a timeline in the plan before starting.
